name: Scales
author: E. T. Carter
description: The flank of a fish seen close: offset rows of rounded scales, each row overlapping the one behind it so only the lower arc of every scale shows, with a soft contact shadow under each overlap and a bright thread along every free edge. Scales grow toward the head, the rows foreshorten as the body turns away, and a slow flex runs down the flank tilting the scales so a band of iridescent highlights travels along it.

params.label: Scale count
params.effect: Scale columns across the frame; low is a few huge scales, high is a fine dense skin.

params.label: Overlap
params.effect: Scale radius against the row pitch; low shows more of each scale, high buries each row deep under the one in front.

params.label: Gloss
params.effect: Strength of the specular, the iridescent sheen and the rim thread on each free edge; 0 is a matte skin.

params.label: Flex
params.effect: Depth of the swimming flex that runs down the body and rocks the scales; 0 holds the flank rigid.

params.label: Speed
params.effect: How fast the flex travels and the light drifts; 0 freezes the flank.
